title: Control Plane weekly sync - quick tidbits
body:
Purpose: quick weekly capture of control plane / routing / auth / quotas updates for people who missed the 10m standup. Informal notes, decisions, and action items.

Attendees: Priya (notes), Ethan, Marina, Samir, Olivia, + async comments from @henry on Slack.

Highlights:
- Control plane leader election fix (RDW-2148) rolled to canary in us-west and reduced API flaps by ~85% in canary. Still watching for replica churn.
- Routing: improved fallback path for model-variant mismatch; cut p99 routing error spikes from 4%->0.4% in staging.
- Auth & quotas: discovered race in quota-metering when token rotation occurs; created hotfix PR and a follow-up design for robust token handoff.

Detailed notes:
1) Control Plane
- Yesterday: Completed canary deploy of leader-election patch (controller backoff adjustments + jitter). Observed stable leader for 72h in canary cluster.
- Today: Expand canary to 3 more nodes in us-east and begin slow rollout to dedicated-controlplane cluster (non-prod first).
- Blockers: cockroachdb schema migration job occasionally times out at 30m mark; investigate long-running DDLs. Relevant ticket: RDW-2201.
- Notes: We should avoid the heavy DDL during peak traffic windows; Marina to coordinate maintenance window with SRE.

2) Routing
- Yesterday: Samir merged routing fallback logic that prefers cached KV until new model artifact is fully validated. See PR: serving-runtime#1012.
- Today: Run longer A/B test with 10% traffic on canary region to ensure no unseen latency regressions.
- Blockers: Lossy telemetry under high batching load making it hard to correlate routing decisions with downstream tail latency. Ethan to add a trace id propagation shim.

3) Auth
- Yesterday: Investigated failed refresh tokens for short-lived service principals during rotation windows. Root cause: slightly out-of-order processing in token cache invalidation.
- Today: Hotfix PR (controlplane#437) created to serialize cache invalidation per principal; pushed to staging. Manual test passes but need longer soak.
- Blockers: Need e2e test that simulates concurrent rotations across 50k tokens. Test infra gap. Olivia to prototype load test harness using k6.

4) Quotas / Metering
- Yesterday: Quota counters occasionally double-count on retry paths when upstream returns 409 + Retry-After.
- Today: Add idempotency token to quota-ing path and enhance logs to emit request-id + quota-op in the same line for easier correlation.
- Blockers: billing pipeline downstream expects incremental counters; changing schema requires a migration plan and billing sync. Finance notified (cc: @Alyssa).

Decisions made:
- Defer heavy cockroachdb DDL work to maintenance window (May 30 00:00-04:00 UTC). Marina to file change freeze notice.
- Ship auth cache serialization hotfix to production only after 48h soak in staging.
- Enable routing fallback A/B test at 10% traffic for 72 hours before wider rollout.

Action items:
- Marina: Schedule DB migration maintenance + update runbook (RDW-2201). due: 2026-05-28.
- Ethan: Implement trace id propagation shim and add telemetry dashboards for routing decisions. due: 2026-05-25.
- Olivia: Prototype k6 token-rotation load test harness and run 50k token scenario. due: 2026-05-27.
- Samir: Monitor A/B test, collect latency buckets and error breakdown, post summary to #eng-platform-controlplane. due: 2026-05-23.
- Priya: Draft post-mortem template for quota double-count incident and coordinate with finance for billing reconciliation. due: 2026-05-26.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Should we add an idempotency ID at the gateway layer rather than per-service for quota operations? Pros/cons: simpler routing vs more cross-service coupling.
- Is 48h soak for auth-hotfix sufficient given token churn patterns? Ops thinks yes but want telemetry guardrails.
- Long term: consider moving the control plane metadata store off Cockroach into a lightweight Raft-consensus service for leadership and coordination only; heavier relational DDLs can live elsewhere. Starter doc: link placeholder (will create RFC).

Quick metrics snapshot (staging / last 24h):
- Control plane API 95p: 320ms, avg: 95ms, errors: 0.6% (down from 3.8%).
- Routing p99: 780ms (canary), p50: 40ms.
- Auth token refresh fail rate: 0.12% (target <0.05%).
- Quota double-count incidents: 4 occurrences in last 48h (manual dedupe applied).

Async notes / miscellaneous:
- Henry reported a flaky test in qt-suite that falsified leader election spike; marked flaky and added to backlog.
- Suggestion: add a small runbook snippet to routing code to explain fallback heuristics to on-call engineers. Samir volunteered to draft.

If you missed standup: please comment here or ping the owners above in Slack. Will snapshot these notes to the internal wiki once items stabilize.

End of notes.
